name: Clay
description: GTM data enrichment and workflow platform with API keys, a CLI and an MCP integration.
auth_notes: Clay API key created in the app (API and CLI, API keys tab) or via the clay api-keys create command; legacy key exists for older integrations.
gate_detail: A Clay account is needed to create a key. A Free plan (500 actions/mo) and 14-day trial exist; webhook automation and HTTP API integration are listed on higher plans. Public API breadth is not documented in sources.
api_scope: Documented API key is for Clay-native integrations such as looking up rows in other tables; a clay CLI exists. No full public REST reference appears in sources.
mcp_notes: Clay documents an MCP connection from workspaces to Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot and Glean, managed by workspace admins.
blocker_detail: Sources document an API key mainly for Clay-native integrations and MCP; breadth of a public developer API and plan requirements are unclear.

evidence.quote: A Clay API key is required for all Clay-native integrations.
In Clay, open API and CLI in the left sidebar, select the API keys tab, and click Add API key .
The key is shown only once, when you create it, so copy it somewhere safe.
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is how Clay connects your workspace to AI tools like Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, and Glean.
Start building in Clay for free. No strings attached.

issues: Sources do not describe a general REST API for outside developers.
Plan required for API key creation is not stated.
Webhooks are mentioned only as an automation feature on higher plans; MCP URL not given.
No independent second pass completed for this app.
